role: separate exploratory controller study; excluded from the preregistered P2 primary causal gate

claim_boundary.eligible: token-t CSA signals predict and select a bounded token-(t+1) hot set on held-out synthetic workloads
ineligible: replacement of a failed preregistered P2 primary arm
claim_boundary.legacy_m3: the full-pass final-query replay pilot is a separate offline negative result and supplies no online-lookahead evidence

causal_contract.features: only CSA rankings and native selections observed while executing token t
causal_contract.decision_time: after all token-t CSA layers finalize and before token-(t+1) sparse-value access
causal_contract.bootstrap: native selection until the first complete prior-token observation exists
causal_contract.future_information: forbidden: token-(t+1) scores, hidden states, targets, answers, quality labels, or later layers from token t+1
causal_contract.predictor: two-head MLP, hidden size 16; sufficient shared top-k plus dense-risk probability
causal_contract.runtime: frozen pure-CPU inference parameters embedded in the cache manifest
causal_contract.normal_budget: predicted shared top-k clipped by the preregistered global budget
causal_contract.dense_budget: calibrated dense-risk fallback clipped by the preregistered dense global budget
causal_contract.protected_pins: count inside the active physical hot-memory budget
causal_contract.determinism: policy, queries, predictions, actions, and cache state are SHA-256 replay bound

splits.unit: conversation; all token pairs from a conversation remain in one split
splits.overlap_policy: exact conversation IDs and generated token sequences must be disjoint across train, calibration, and test
splits.test_access: one terminal evaluation after model and thresholds are frozen; no retuning

labels.budget: minimum shared per-layer top-k at token t+1 that preserves the dense next-token prediction under the registered sweep
labels.dense: no registered normal-budget top-k preserves the dense next-token prediction
labels.label_generation: training and calibration splits only; test labels are opened solely for terminal scoring

statistics.pairing: same checkpoint, conversation, token position, budget, and deterministic arm rotation
statistics.interval: paired cluster bootstrap 95% CI with 10000 resamples
statistics.tests: paired two-sided permutation; Holm correction across scale-budget primary cells
statistics.effect: paired accuracy difference and selected-block/HBM ratios

positive_gate.scope: all 5 seeds at both scales and both 2x/4x budgets
positive_gate.quality: online-learned-lookahead+pins exceeds one-token-training-free+pins in all 5 seed means and has a positive seed-cluster bootstrap 95% CI in every scale-budget cell
positive_gate.pareto: quality exceeds memory-matched-fixed+pins without higher measured hot HBM or useful transfer bytes
positive_gate.regression: no family-context slice loses more than 2 percentage points versus memory-matched-fixed+pins
positive_gate.budget: zero logical or physical budget violations
positive_gate.replay: all cache lifecycle and replay digests verify
positive_gate.overhead: report unconditionally; no post-hoc overhead threshold
positive_gate.five_seed_test_resolution: report exact/sign-randomization p-values and Holm adjustments, but do not require p<0.05 because a two-sided 5-pair exact sign test has minimum attainable p=0.0625

failure_rules.gate_failure: bounded negative result for this predictor, feature set, scales, and budgets only
failure_rules.test_tuning: invalidate and rerun from a new preregistered seed namespace
failure_rules.budget_violation: fail affected arm and retain the record
failure_rules.runtime_failure: retain denominator and report by type; never silently drop

execution_equivalence.checkpoint_reuse_probe: for every one of 5 seeds at both scales, compare one calibration label shard and one held-out test shard from a reused checkpoint instance against a freshly loaded checkpoint instance
execution_equivalence.equality_fields: generation seeds, label rows, quality records, controller accounting, physical accounting, and policy digests must match exactly; wall-clock timing fields are excluded
execution_equivalence.failure_action: withhold the online learned-lookahead result if any probe, child artifact digest, or implementation digest differs

execution_order: only after the frozen P2 causal summary is terminal; never modify or delay P2 core/causal execution
